objective: Does carrying w open distinctions at once, instead of waiting a phase for each open use, save phases and parallel rounds in atom patterns, and does copying a carried distinction (one strand into two that rejoin) save what carrying alone cannot? Measure on small random atom patterns, layered circuits, ladders and pyramids; prove the no-copy invariant; say plainly whether the braid picture explains anything the classical pebbling statement does not. Serves G3. Takes SEQUENTIAL-WALL-20261116-001#1.
status: Complete 2026-11-16 (Successful; refereed CARRY-STRANDS-R1, confirmed with fixes, no Block): the owner's braid made exact for forcing is register allocation and pebbling. Spend-only carrying of w distinctions gives ceil(sigma/w) phases and never fewer than sigma doubling rounds; keeping (one strand splitting into two that rejoin) pays exactly where strands rejoin (ladders: one phase with two carried, rounds 2k to log2(4k)). Random atom patterns and random circuits contain little rejoining (in the median sample keeping saves a phase for 0% of distinctions before the jump's narrowest phase, 6-12% after); spend-only w = 2 cuts rounds by 22-32%. 2 of 7 predictions held (corrected).
title: Carrying distinctions together: the owner's braid made exact for forcing
